skills.detail:
A long-range multiple hit attack that inflicts a SPD debuff with a chance to inflict Slow-Slow state.
Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP.
This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Slow-Slow Beam

skills.detail:
Moves towards enemies at long-range and attacks multiple times.
Damage dealt will disregard the enemy DEF stat.
When dealing damage to an enemy inflicted with the Slow-Slow state, deals an additional amount of fixed damage.
This will deal a fixed amount of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit.
Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: Nine-Tails Rush
